name: Termeh
about: A sequential ramp made for water surface elevation and depth rasters, following the termeh's blue ground from foam light to deep indigo. The colors are named for the water they are meant to carry: Foam Mist, Glacial Blue, Powder Aqua, River Teal, Slate Blue, Deep Channel and Night Current.
notes: Powder Aqua, light ground between motifs
River Teal, the twill ground itself
Slate Blue, shaded folds of the ground
Deep Channel, blue fill of the boteh
Night Current, the darkest indigo threads
